name: Shaul
overview: The name Shaul appears in Scripture referring to distinct individuals, highlighting its use across different contexts. Shaul is noted as a son of Simeon, born to a Canaanitish woman, establishing a family lineage within the tribe of Simeon (Exodus 6:15; Genesis 46:10; 1 Chronicles 4:24). Another Shaul is recorded as an ancient king of Edom, succeeding Samlah and reigning from Rehoboth by the river (Genesis 36:37). Additionally, Shaul is mentioned as a son of Uzziah, illustrating a genealogical connection within the broader biblical narrative (1 Chronicles 6:24). These references collectively demonstrate the historical and genealogical significance of the name Shaul in Scripture.
